1.consolidated_definition: Adjetivo que califica al gallo que es rápido y certero en el tiro de la espuela. Este gallo es temible porque corta al contrincante con facilidad. Existe la variante espuelero. Refiriéndose a esta cualidad, dice un viejo gallero, “Hay galloh que se tiran pa’rriba y son dos tajos. Al soltárselo al otro le saca los ojos enseguida.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: Adjective describing a rooster that is swift and precise in the spur kick. This rooster is formidable because it easily cuts down its opponent. A variant of this term is spur kicker. Referring to this quality, an old cocker says, "There are roosters that kick upwards and they deliver two blows. When they release themselves on the other, they take their eyes out right away."
